name: Log Size / VC Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, log size is at least VC dimension.
proof: A shattered set of size $d=\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$ realizes all $2^d$ binary traces, each supplied by a distinct member of $\mathcal H$. Thus $|\mathcal H|\geq2^d$, and taking base-two logarithms gives $\log_2|\mathcal H|\geq d$.
